The letter was dated forty years earlier and written by a girl named Elsa, who asked whoever found it to write back and tell her whether the sea had been kind. Tomas read it three times. That afternoon he wrote a reply, describing the gulls, the fog, and the light he kept, and mailed it anyway.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有醒来。街灯一盏接一盏地亮着，把空荡的马路照得发白。偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，轮胎压过积水，声音很快消失在远处。便利店的玻璃门后，店员趴在柜台上打盹，冰柜嗡嗡作响。高楼的窗户大多黑着，只有几格还亮着灯，也许有人在加班，也许有人失眠。环卫工人推着车慢慢走过，扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。风从楼宇之间穿过，带着一点凉意。东边的天空还是深蓝色，但再过一会儿，第一班公交车就要出发了。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine Russian nesting dolls: to find the tiniest doll, you open one doll, then do the same thing to the doll inside.\n- You keep going until you reach the smallest doll that doesn't open, and that's where you stop."}
